messages:
marta: Quick sync — we're aiming to announce the 'Adaptive Cache v2' rollout next Wed (03/27). Need: final changelog blurb, docs links, benchmark callouts, canary timing. Webinar signup going live Thu. @samuel @ara @leo please.

leo: Got it. What's the exact copy for changelog? short bullets ok?

samuel: We plan a staged canary across east-us → west-us over 2 hours. Canary tickets: 10%, 30%, 100%. Need a fallback plan to old model. Also, confirm model artifacts are tagged 'adaptive-v2-20260327'.

ara: I'll draft the docs. Please post the docs PR and any migration notes. Also need the exact API examples to paste.

marta: Draft changelog bullets: - nearly 2x latency for short responses, - better KV-cache reuse for streaming, - smaller memory footprint. Jen flagged benchmarks — we need validation before publishing the exact figure. @jen

jen: Please don't use the hard '2x' wording until benchmark CI passes. If it's 1.8x we'll adjust. I'll run the perf job today.

samuel: Perf run kicked off. Fyi the canary script is below:

```sh
./rollout --model adaptive-v2 --steps 10,30,60 --wait 10m
```

We can compress if needed.

leo: Marketing assets: webinar landing page needs the docs link and a short performance chart. ara can you add a sample curl snippet?

ara: Yes — will add curl + python snippets. PR: https://github.com/redwood/docs/pull/482 (draft).

marta: Can we freeze changelog text by EOD today? Marketing needs final for send queue.

jen: Perf CI finished: short-response latency improvement 1.95x (p95) in our synthetic bench. I'll attach the run id: run-20260320-7.

marta: Nice. Let's say 'nearly 2x' to be safe.

leo: :thumbsup: I'll update the copy: 'Nearly 2x latency improvement on short responses (p95) in our bench suite'.

samuel: Canary windows: start Wed 10:00 PT, 10% for 20m, 30% for 30m, 100% after rollback window. Will push the rollout job at 09:50 PT and monitor.

marta: Inbound lead routing: marketing wants a tag 'adaptive-v2' on leads from the webinar. @samuel can you make sure webhook includes variant metadata?

samuel: Yep — I'll add 'release_variant: adaptive-v2' to the event payload. ETA tonight.

ara: Docs PR updated with examples and migration notes. Link: https://github.com/redwood/docs/pull/482/files — ready for review.

leo: Webinar script: start with benchmark chart, quick demo of reduced latency, then Q&A. Can someone share the benchmark figure PNG? jen?

jen: Uploading PNG to the assets bucket now — link: https://assets.redwood.ai/releases/adaptive-v2/bench-p95.png

marta: Alright final checklist: changelog text (leo) ✅, docs link (ara) ✅, perf figure (jen) ✅, canary schedule (samuel) ✅, webinar page live Thu AM (leo). Any last blockers?

samuel: One small blocker: if error rates spike we fallback to adaptive-v1 automatically. I'll document the exact fallback behavior in the runbook.

marta: Perfect. I'll queue the announce draft once leo drops the changelog. Thanks all :rocket:
